citations.text_span: Coupon amounts accrue on a Actual/360 day count basis.

triage.desk_query: Term sheet G03 states: "Coupon amounts accrue on a Actual/360 day count basis." The booking record carries day_count = 30/360, which conflicts with the documented Actual/360 basis and will misstate accrued coupon amounts. Please confirm whether the booking should be amended to ACT/360, or provide the executed amendment or supplemental term sheet supporting 30/360. Response needed before the next coupon accrual run.
triage.cited_clause: Coupon amounts accrue on a Actual/360 day count basis.
triage.rationale: Both extractors agree on an unambiguous, explicit term sheet clause specifying Actual/360, so the divergent booking value is the likely error.

triage.desk_query: Term sheet G03 states "Volatility Target 10% per annum" for the underlying index, but the booking record carries index_vol_target_pct = 12. Both extractors agree on the term sheet figure of 10, so the booking appears to be off by two points. Please confirm the correct volatility target and, if 10% is right, authorise correction of index_vol_target_pct from 12 to 10; if the booking reflects a later amendment or a different index series, send the supporting document.
triage.rationale: The term sheet states the volatility target unambiguously and both extractors concur, so the divergent booking value is the more likely error.
